summary_en: 1,000,019 shares to be cancelled (0.95% of shares outstanding). Post-cancellation issued shares: 104,012,157. Effective date 2026-07-31.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Allied Telesis Holdings K.K. announced on 2026-07-21 that its board of directors resolved to cancel 1,000,019 treasury shares pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares represent 0.95% of issued shares outstanding (computed as 1,000,019 ÷ 105,012,176 ex-treasury). The cancellation will be effective 2026-07-31. Following the cancellation, total issued shares will be 104,012,157 and treasury shares retained will be 1,000,000.
